company.name: Tax Star
company.shortDescription: Tax Star provides a tax prep app with document organization, tax estimators, and guidance for W‑2, 1099, and small‑business needs.
company.description: Tax Star provides a tax preparation app that supports individuals and small businesses throughout the filing cycle. The platform organizes receipts and forms, categorizes expenses, and estimates taxes for common scenarios such as W‑2 employment and 1099 contracting. Step‑by‑step questionnaires and checklists guide data entry needed for federal and state forms, including income, deductions, and credits. Features include document capture, storage, and progress tracking to keep tasks aligned with deadlines. Export options help share compiled data with a tax professional or transfer information for manual submission. Educational resources outline key rules and timelines to help users plan payments and reduce errors.
